limits: Installed @napi-rs/canvas raster math (putImageData is wrapped to ignore CTM, correcting the installed library’s non-spec behavior) plus shipped handlers in controlled DOM; no Android WebView, Chromium UI, model or handset execution.
passes: rotate clockwise and horizontal/vertical flips preserve every opaque pixel exactly
four rotations and double flips are exact full-frame identities
integer-aligned crop picks exact source pixels including right and bottom boundaries
fractional crop current renderer and planning round dimensions consistently
mixed ordered crop/manual/tone/flip/rotate project roundtrip and replay are deterministic
crop cancel/reset and rejected transform confirmation preserve earlier manual history
crop pointer cancellation, lost capture and late pointerup cannot commit transient geometry
completed face result is reused on unchanged pixels but invalidated after every geometry/history change
in-flight face callback after geometry commit cannot populate a new draft
new shared geometry mixes with legacy crops, repair, liquify and tone without replay drift
crop Apply plus transform buttons write new geometry history and keep original Blob/undo
fixed corner selection uses nearest handle and narrow ratio resizing stays in source bounds
new geometry invalidates face coordinates and rejects old in-flight results like legacy operations
full-frame shrink then small-crop center drag moves without resizing; outside gesture has no effect
